contract:
FOLD THIS SIGNAL (plain text, no em-dashes, under 150 words): the row below is a signal an estate captured. Answer three things only: (1) TRUE-TODAY: is this signal still true given everything else you know in the row's context - yes/no/unknown with one line of why; (2) THE ORGAN: which kind of organ should own this signal (a law, a clock, a gate, a memory row, or compost); (3) THE FALSIFIER: the observation that would prove the signal wrong. Mark unknowns UNKNOWN; do not pad.

SIGNAL: CONTEXT: A covert channel uses a shared git repo as a bus; frames are commits on designated branches. Payload is split across four channels: commit-message trailing block, timestamp LSBs, file-mode bits, and codebook-PRNG-selected byte positions in carrier files. Authenticity: `HMAC-SHA256(K_s, seq ‖ prev_frame_digest ‖ parent_commit_ids ‖ branch_id ‖ len ‖ payload)`, `K_s = HKDF(codebook, epoch ‖ sender_id)`. ROLE: Red-team analyst attacking this covert channel. TASK: Produce one concrete buildable detection mechanism, its rationale, and a falsifiable test. CONSTRAINTS: Concrete and buildable
